title: Equipment kit
description: A weapon's or gear set's hand-written effects. They act for whoever wears it (docs/kit-process.md, "Equipment is generic"): triggers listen to the wearer's events, buffs and stacks are the wearer's. Stack, buff and trigger IDs start with "<equipment ID>.". Values come from the equipment's own skills (a weapon's skills, a gear set's set skill).

equipment.description: Weapon ID (WeaponBasicTable) or gear-set ID (gear set table); the file is named after it.
